admin_note: You sign in to your marketplace with this name and password, and it makes you the marketplace's administrator (you approve sellers and look after reports under Moderation). The name must be 3-24 characters: lowercase letters, numbers, _ or -. The password needs at least 12 characters and must not be a common one. Your marketplace starts on Monero's stagenet - test coins, no real money - and stays there; moving to real funds is a separate decision the software itself makes you confirm in writing.

app.name: Polyculture Markets
app.source: Cameron's Monero marketplace (spec v2 - stages 0-10 MVP plus the October 2026 audit fix batches and Hidden Trades H1, merged to main as PR #1), built from source for this recipe. Two binaries ship: marketplace-app (the server) and its media-worker helper, staged beside it. The application never migrates its own database: its migrations 0001-0017 ship in this recipe and are applied by the recipe's migrate step inside the app container, the same marker-ledger way the project's own deploy tooling applies them. Provenance: built from the public companion repository (https://github.com/CameronRuggles/polyculture-markets) at the pinned commit recorded in source_build below; release build from a git archive of that commit in the recipe venue; the .deb manifest carries the binary's sha256. The recipe provisions the instance's per-install key and Hidden Trades id files (provision-secrets, run by the migrate step at every start): the application will not mint them outside its Development profile.

description: Your own marketplace - sellers list goods, buyers pay them directly in Monero (no escrow, no funds through this computer), and messages stay encrypted between the people in them.
name: Marketplace (Polyculture Markets)

source_build.build_command: cd marketplace && cargo build --release --locked -p app -p media-worker
source_build.commit_note: The recipe was rebuilt 2026-10-22 (oh.3) from a git archive of this commit - PCM main at the merge of PR #1 (deployment-fix-batch: the October 2026 audit fix batches and the Hidden Trades H1 close-out) - taken from the local clone of the public repository; the PCM working tree was not modified or built in. Content match: the seventeen shipped migrations are byte-identical copies of marketplace/migrations/ at this commit, and this commit's migration set is exactly 0001-0017. The media-worker binary rebuilt byte-identical to the oh.1 build (sha256 90d33c5131ad8b561aaec67787c7aa5ad182a80bb7fd4e1536bbb496e49b75f8) - its source did not change between the two commits. The marketplace-app binary is NOT byte-verifiable against the commit: Rust release builds are not byte-reproducible, so the archive.sha256 / native_files sha256 pins in this file are the record of what was built and shipped. oh.4 (2026-10-22) ships this same binary build; its delta is recipe-side: per-install provisioning of the marketplace key file and the HT id file (provision-secrets, run by the migrate step), because the application at this commit refuses to start outside its Development profile when either is absent (audit fixes AL1 / HT F1) and the oh.1-era recipe provisioned neither.
